title: 咎狗の血

guide_target.label: 咎狗の血（2005年2月25日・初回限定版／オリジナル18禁PC版・ScriptVersion 1.00）

routes.title: ケイスケ（GOOD／BAD×2／アルビトロBAD）
routes.notes: Start with Keisuke. Original unpatched ScriptVersion1.00 first answer is 「……」 (shown by otomenotomo); HalfAdder's 「やっぱりダメだ」 is the adjusted opening for 1.01 to keep bad-end choices available. Three Keisuke-relative bad branches: first scream, take Arbitro's bread, or answer 判らない. Keisuke's additional CG appears via Nano later.

routes.title: リン（GOOD）
routes.notes: One ending, no bad branch; must clear this route to unlock Shiki. Route's optional post-clear choice markers must not be emitted prematurely.

routes.title: 源泉（GOOD）
routes.notes: One good ending; no bad ending. Conditional なんとも思わない and 目を逸らす appear after Rin clear.

routes.title: シキ（GOOD／BAD×2）
routes.notes: Requires completed Rin route. Two independent BAD branches: 叫ぶ, and 見ている事ができない after 声を飲みこむ; GOOD uses 声を飲みこむ→違う.

routes.title: キリヲ（BAD）
routes.notes: Executioner BAD ending from 腕を振り払う→右へ進む. Does not count as an ordinary romance-route good clear.

routes.title: グンジ（BAD）
routes.notes: Executioner BAD ending from 腕を振り払う→左へ進む. Does not count as an ordinary romance-route good clear.

routes.title: ｎ／謎の男（最終ルート）
routes.notes: Available after completing Keisuke, Rin, Motomi and Shiki GOOD endings; neutral choices suppress all four affinities until late common-route 近付いてみる, then 真似てみる. Recommended last. A previously made save before the late choice may be used, per HalfAdder, but no documented save slot/position is included.

disagreements: Exact target is the Japanese 2005-02-25 original first-press Windows 18+ CD (launch ScriptVersion1.00). Exclude PS2/PSP『True Blood』, its 2025 PC NITRO ARCHIVE, and Yukihito's later route. Otomenotomo is unpatched and correctly uses 「……」 at the first choice for Keisuke. HalfAdder explicitly adjusts that first choice to 「やっぱりダメだ」 under ScriptVersion1.01 because choosing the ellipsis hides some BAD options after patch. The original guide must use the launch/original choice; keep patch incompatibility in route notes. HalfAdder parenthesized choices occur only after specific ending flags; do not show them prematurely: Rin clear enables なんとも思わない, 目を逸らす and Shiki-related choices; 近付いてみる after all four GOODs unlocks n. Otomenotomo's HTML table combines nested executioner divergence alongside the Rin column; interpreted as a separate 腕を振り払う action, not the Rin-good-path arm response. Good/Bad counts: Keisuke GOOD and two personal BADs, plus Arbitro BAD; Rin GOOD; Motomi GOOD; Shiki GOOD plus two BADs; Kiriwar BAD; Gunji BAD; n TRUE = 12 endings. Source sets do not provide exact save-slot positions. Consequently no invented save or load commands; alternate bad endings are replayed from the opening (full documented choice prefixes) prior to the GOOD path. Character portraits are verified by publisher character identifiers and indexed character illustrations; n is represented by a tagged art image. Cover lookup located the visually matching original art on an older review (https://i.imgur.com/vnJy9H2.jpg); verify the exact first-print box front before treating this as final display metadata.
